0022600196.text: The Bulls (1-7, on a six-game losing streak) host the 76ers (8-2, first in the East and the Atlantic) in Chicago's ninth game of the 2026-27 season, with Chicago 0-2 at home, 14th in the East, and five games back in the Central, while Philadelphia has won eight of its last ten and enters on a one-game losing streak. Chicago is without Nic Claxton (hamstring strain) and Zach Collins (illness), both listed as out, and Jalen Smith (finger sprain), Norman Powell (shoulder inflammation), and Tobe Awaka (knee sprain) are day-to-day with game-time decisions, while Philadelphia will be missing Adem Bona (back sprain), Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery), and Dominick Barlow (back fracture), with Joel Embiid (plantar fasciitis in his foot) day-to-day and also a game-time decision. Philadelphia won the last meeting 126-107 in Philadelphia on November 2, 2026, leaving the Bulls trailing 0-1 this season, after they won the 2025-26 series 2-1.
